item.title: News
item.description: [Aug 3, 2026] I have joined AstraZeneca in Cambridge as a postdoc, to work on machine learning and computer vision for multimodal digital pathology. [Jul 31, 2026] Accepted papers: (1) Semantic Self-Distillation for Language Model Uncertainty has been accepted to UAI 2026, (2) BAS: A Decision-Theoretic Approach to Evaluating Large Language Model Confidence to COLM 2026, and (3) Efficient Image Restoration with State-Dependent Forward Diffusion to TMLR. [Jul 23, 2026] Updated preprint: Evaluation and Prognostic Validation of Deep Regression Models for WSI-Based Gene-Expression Prediction [arXiv] [project].
